description: This file defines a static utility class 'ImageValidators' that provides methods to validate image files based on size and extension criteria.

classes.name: ImageValidators
classes.description: A static class providing image validation methods, including size and extension checks.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Validates if a byte array represents a valid image file based on size and extension validity.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks if the file extension of the given filename is among the accepted image formats (.jpg, .png, .gif, .jpeg).
